company.name: Prospa
company.shortDescription: Prospa is an Australian owned and operated online lending service provider for small businesses within the region.
company.description:
Prospa provides unsecured business loans to small businesses in Australia and is Australian owned and operated. Using a smart proprietary technology platform and a simple online application process, Prospa gives small business owners a fast and easy way to access finance, and has already helped thousands of Australian small businesses. 

In 2015 Prospa won the Deloitte Tech Fast 50 with 6071% growth over three years, making it the fastest growing technology company in Australia, and the third fastest in Asia. Prospa was a 2015 Telstra Business Awards finalist and rated 33rd globally as a leading innovator in KPMG's Fintech 100.

productsAndServices.description: A fixed-term loan from $5K to $150K for small businesses to cover expenses or growth, repaid weekly with fixed interest rates and no upfront asset security required.
productsAndServices.name: Prospa Small Business Loan

productsAndServices.description: A fixed-term loan from $150K to $500K for established businesses to fund larger expenses, requiring asset security and offering dedicated lending specialist support.
productsAndServices.name: Prospa Business Loan Plus

productsAndServices.description: A renewable 24-month credit facility up to $500K providing ongoing access to funds with interest charged only on the amount used, no upfront asset security required up to $150K.
productsAndServices.name: Prospa Business Line of Credit

productsAndServices.description: A digital business transaction account linked to a Visa Debit card for managing business finances, enabling payments, transfers, and ATM withdrawals with security controls.
productsAndServices.name: Prospa Business Account and Visa Business Debit Card
